title: Edison This is the Shop

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: See ya found the place. Not a bad spot am I right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See ya found the place. Not a bad spot am I right?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Yeah, Alex is a little overzealous. You should meet his twin sister! Actually, you should talk with her after we're done with business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, Alex is a little overzealous. You should meet his twin sister! Actually, you should talk with her after we're done with business.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: What did Mica tell you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did Mica tell you?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: You... You talked about Masato? With Alexander? Shit. Oh, shit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You... You talked about Masato? With Alexander? Shit. Oh, shit.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I still believe in the mission... but this is my damn niece. It's family. I gotta find a way out of this mess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still believe in the mission... but this is my damn niece. It's family. I gotta find a way out of this mess.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: They call Masato "The Scorpion" because he'll clasp his claws around you and poison you in the most painful way possible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They call Masato "The Scorpion" because he'll clasp his claws around you and poison you in the most painful way possible.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: He tracked down the gangers who murdered his parents and killed the whole lot of 'em with a sharpened circuit board. So they say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He tracked down the gangers who murdered his parents and killed the whole lot of 'em with a sharpened circuit board. So they say.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: The Scorpion knows the twins. He knows everyone in the underworld. And he knows where to find 'em if they ever cross him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Scorpion knows the twins. He knows everyone in the underworld. And he knows where to find 'em if they ever cross him.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: ...We should stop talkin' about him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...We should stop talkin' about him.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: If Masato hears someone say his name, he'll come to find out who opened their mouth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If Masato hears someone say his name, he'll come to find out who opened their mouth.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Before you know it you're lifeless on the ground and someone, somewhere is getting nightmares when they find your body.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Before you know it you're lifeless on the ground and someone, somewhere is getting nightmares when they find your body.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It will be fine. Fine!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It will be fine. Fine!

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: That lying shit. Look, we need to talk about something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That lying shit. Look, we need to talk about something.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: My niece vanished from the Corps databases, but I know she's alive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My niece vanished from the Corps databases, but I know she's alive.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I know who has her. My old boss Freya Portlet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know who has her. My old boss Freya Portlet.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Let's get back to the poisoning. You believe me when I say I didn't know, right? They told me what to do, but I had NO idea of the plan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's get back to the poisoning. You believe me when I say I didn't know, right? They told me what to do, but I had NO idea of the plan.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I confronted my boss Freya about the poisoning and she blew me off... Then Haley vanished from the Corp's registers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I confronted my boss Freya about the poisoning and she blew me off... Then Haley vanished from the Corp's registers.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: My stomach turned near inside out. I thought she was dead. I collapsed like a bag o bones. I was on the floor when Freya found me, told me She had her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My stomach turned near inside out. I thought she was dead. I collapsed like a bag o bones. I was on the floor when Freya found me, told me She had her.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: These superrich assholes make deals all the time. It wouldn't be hard for her to find an angle to get one kid back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: These superrich assholes make deals all the time. It wouldn't be hard for her to find an angle to get one kid back.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Yeah, but she's in Freya's hands now. My niece is leverage, and I gotta do what The Network says.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, but she's in Freya's hands now. My niece is leverage, and I gotta do what The Network says.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I swear I didn't know until yesterday. I thought I'm helping people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I swear I didn't know until yesterday. I thought I'm helping people.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: For what it's worth, I think Edison is being truthful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For what it's worth, I think Edison is being truthful.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Now she's got me by the balls. Freya says I'll be free the day my niece turns 21. That's another 11 years.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now she's got me by the balls. Freya says I'll be free the day my niece turns 21. That's another 11 years.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Am I supposed to believe that? Neither of us are ever gettin' out of this. We know too much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Am I supposed to believe that? Neither of us are ever gettin' out of this. We know too much.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have a bad feeling. Edison may do something foolish. You have to give him some hope, or I fear...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a bad feeling. Edison may do something foolish. You have to give him some hope, or I fear...

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: The Network is still saving kids. Something changed, but I'm too low down the chain to know what.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Network is still saving kids. Something changed, but I'm too low down the chain to know what.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Looks like they fucked up my life like they did to you with the poisoning. Only worse. Guess I should have seen this comin'. I gotta go. But if you think of a way out of this... well, you're the only friend I got left. Let me know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looks like they fucked up my life like they did to you with the poisoning. Only worse. Guess I should have seen this comin'. I gotta go. But if you think of a way out of this... well, you're the only friend I got left. Let me know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It wasn't easy to get in here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It wasn't easy to get in here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It wasn't easy to get in here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It wasn't easy to get in here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your security guard Alex is...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your security guard Alex is...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your security guard Alex is...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your security guard Alex is...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The beer wasn't enough to get past. I had to mention the Scorpion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The beer wasn't enough to get past. I had to mention the Scorpion.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The beer wasn't enough to get past. I had to mention the Scorpion.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The beer wasn't enough to get past. I had to mention the Scorpion.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why did you call me in the first place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why did you call me in the first place?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why did you call me in the first place?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why did you call me in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mica said you don't have a niece.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mica said you don't have a niece.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Mica said you don't have a niece.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Mica said you don't have a niece.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the problem?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the problem?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What's the problem?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What's the problem?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't even know who Masato was.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't even know who Masato was.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn't even know who Masato was.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn't even know who Masato was.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems like a nice fella.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems like a nice fella.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seems like a nice fella.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seems like a nice fella.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does this have to do with Alexander?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does this have to do with Alexander?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What does this have to do with Alexander?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What does this have to do with Alexander?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who is this guy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who is this guy?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Who is this guy?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Who is this guy?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks Ava...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks Ava...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks Ava...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks Ava...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And Alexander fears him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And Alexander fears him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And Alexander fears him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And Alexander fears him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You better have a good explanation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You better have a good explanation.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You better have a good explanation.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You better have a good explanation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm listening.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you telling the truth?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you telling the truth?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you telling the truth?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you telling the truth?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If the Corps don't have her files, she's dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If the Corps don't have her files, she's dead.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If the Corps don't have her files, she's dead.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If the Corps don't have her files, she's dead.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's say I believe you...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's say I believe you...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Let's say I believe you...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Let's say I believe you...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not convinced.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not convinced.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not convinced.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not convinced.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She betrayed you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She betrayed you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She betrayed you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She betrayed you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How could Freya get a Gen Debt kid from LifeCorp?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How could Freya get a Gen Debt kid from LifeCorp?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How could Freya get a Gen Debt kid from LifeCorp?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How could Freya get a Gen Debt kid from LifeCorp?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So your niece is free of CorpSec?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So your niece is free of CorpSec?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So your niece is free of CorpSec?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So your niece is free of CorpSec?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So Mica was right? It's all just a scam to make money off kids.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So Mica was right? It's all just a scam to make money off kids.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So Mica was right? It's all just a scam to make money off kids.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So Mica was right? It's all just a scam to make money off kids.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So The Network will screw over anyone to get what it wants?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So The Network will screw over anyone to get what it wants?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So The Network will screw over anyone to get what it wants?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So The Network will screw over anyone to get what it wants?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe if we figure out how The Network operates we can disrupt them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe if we figure out how The Network operates we can disrupt them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe if we figure out how The Network operates we can disrupt them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe if we figure out how The Network operates we can disrupt them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My Automata made me mention Masato Shima to get in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My Automata made me mention Masato Shima to get in.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: My Automata made me mention Masato Shima to get in.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: My Automata made me mention Masato Shima to get in.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We need to stop The Network.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We need to stop The Network.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We need to stop The Network.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We need to stop The Network.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe we should go along with Freya's plans for now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe we should go along with Freya's plans for now.
